# Shiny app walkthrough {#shiny-app}

This chapter walks through every panel and control in the
single-study viewer. The R and Python apps are visually equivalent;
screenshots and labels apply to both.

## Layout {-}

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|  Study title (long title + species + n_cells + n_genes)   |
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|  Study Info & Controls  |  Clusters                        |
|  - Cells:    8,464/8,464|  ☑ TEX_intermediate  ▮▮▮  count |
|  - Coordinate: UMAP     |  ☑ TEX_progenitor    ▮▮   count |
|  - Dot Size:  [4]       |  ☑ TEX_terminally    ▮▮▮▮ count |
|  - Show Labels: [on]    |                                  |
|  - Sampling %: [100]    |                                  |
|                          |                                 |
|  Gene Selection         |                                  |
|  [Type to add gene(s)…] |                                  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|  Cluster Plot | Heatmap | Bubble | Feature | Violin | Net.|
|                                                            |
|  (active tab content here)                                 |
|                                                            |
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
```

## Study Info & Controls {-}

* **Cells** — displayed live as `visible / total`. Visible cells
  honour both the cluster table checkboxes and the Sampling %.
* **Coordinate** — read-only; shows the coordinate system (e.g. UMAP).
* **Dot Size** — affects cluster + feature plots.
* **Show Labels** — toggles cluster-name annotations on the cluster
  plot (positions come from the `label_1` / `label_2` columns in
  `study$clusters`).
* **Sampling %** — per-cluster proportional downsampling. The session
  shuffles each cluster's cell indices once; the reactive then takes
  the first `pct%` from each shuffled vector. Deterministic for a
  given `(cluster, pct)` so plots don't flicker between tabs. Auto-set
  to `floor(65_000 / n_cells * 100)` when the study has more than
  65K cells.

## Clusters {-}

A 4-column table: **Show** (checkbox), **Cluster**, **Cells**, **Color**.

* **Show** — a per-row HTML `<input type="checkbox">`. Toggling fires
  a Shiny event (`Shiny.setInputValue('cluster_checkbox', …)`) that
  updates the visible cluster set. The checkbox's `checked` attribute
  is sourced from the server state, so it survives Sampling %
  changes (no "uncheck → change sampling → all clusters back on"
  surprise).
* **Cells** — `visible / total`, live-updated by the Sampling %
  control. *Visible* counts how many of that cluster's cells survive
  the sampling mask; *total* is the underlying study count from the
  bundle.
* **Color** — the per-cluster swatch (from the bundle's
  `/clusters/color` dataset).

## Gene Selection {-}

Server-side `selectizeInput` (R) / `input_selectize` (Python) keyed
off the bundle's `genes/symbol` master list. Type-ahead is debounced;
only the first ~200 matches are sent to the browser per query.

If the bundle has a `/defaults/genes` group, those genes are
pre-selected on startup. Genes can be removed with the `×` button on
each chip (R) or by clicking the chip (Python).

## Plot tabs {-}

### Cluster Plot {-}

A 2D scatter of all cells (after sampling + cluster filter), colored
by `cellType`. Optionally annotated with cluster labels positioned at
the `label_1` / `label_2` coordinates from the bundle.

### Heatmap {-}

Gene × cluster mean of values across each cluster's sampled cells.
Diverging **blue-white-red** palette (ColorBrewer RdBu reversed,
`zmid = 0`) so positive values lean red and negative (e.g. z-scored
activity) lean blue.

### Bubble Plot {-}

Gene × cluster: dot size encodes pct expressing (fraction of cells
with non-zero value), dot color encodes the mean.

### Feature Plot (3-level nested) {-}

```
Feature Plot
├── Gene tab: Mrpl15
│   ├── Cell Type pill: All
│   │   └── Card: Expression | TF | SIG    (each is a per-cell scatter)
│   ├── Cell Type pill: TEX_intermediate
│   │   └── Card: Expression | TF | SIG
│   ├── Cell Type pill: TEX_progenitor
│   │   └── Card: Expression | TF | SIG
│   └── Cell Type pill: TEX_terminally
│       └── Card: Expression | TF | SIG
├── Gene tab: Stat1
│   └── ...
```

* Outermost: per-gene tabs from the gene selectize.
* Middle: cell-type pills (`All` + every cluster). `All` shows the
  full UMAP coloured by gene value; picking a single cluster shows
  only those cells.
* Innermost: a card-pill switcher for **Expression** / **TF** / **SIG**.

### Violin Plot {-}

Same 3-level nesting as Feature Plot. With `All` selected, every
cluster gets its own violin side-by-side; picking a single cluster
shows a single violin (useful for comparing Expression vs TF vs SIG
within one cluster).

### Network {-}

Same nesting, except the relationship card has only **TF** / **SIG**
(there is no expression network). Each edge in the bundle is
associated with a `cellType`; selecting a cell-type pill filters the
network to just those edges.

The network is rendered with `visNetwork` (R) or `networkx` +
`plotly` (Python). Up to 60 edges around the focal gene are shown,
sorted by `|mi|`.

## Multi-study browser {-}

`run_browser(root_dir)` (R) and `scminer-viewer browse <root_dir>`
(Python) render a card-grid index — one card per study found by
`discover_studies()`. Each card shows the shortTitle, studyAbbr,
species, n_cells × n_genes × n_clusters, and the longTitle (clamped
with a `title=` hover-tooltip for the full text).

Clicking a card opens the standard single-study layout above, with a
"← Back to studies" link in the top-left.
